authority: reviewer 2026-09-19: harness repair first. A disconnected FEF and PFC show the same apparent response, so the current estimator cannot identify transmission. Authorized a harness lineage to build a causal estimator with stimulus ON/OFF paired runs at matched initial state and RNG, contrasted against the g = 0 control.
objective: replace the propagation estimator with one that cannot call intrinsic phase drift propagation, and measure the tolerance it must exceed. This lineage repairs a measuring instrument; it asks no question about the model.
expression: x : {V1^2 X[lat]} O[fffb] {V4^2 X[lat]} O[fffb] {FEF X[lat] PFC} : y
y: FEF.L6.E.v(t), retained population-resolved as v_i(t), never only the mean
retina_definition_status: RETINA_DEFINITION_REQUIRED, drafted as RETINA[jomission_v0], pending approval

retina.draft: pending reviewer approval; no execution may consume this until approved

stimulus.note: the spot lies entirely in the left hemifield, so V1.2 is reached only through X[lat] and the V4 level

retinal tonic zeroed: the retina is silent absent stimulus

provenance.N: DEFINITION_CHOICE: the checkpoint architecture declares Retina^1024
provenance.GRID: DEFINITION_CHOICE: G[Retina] = 32 x 32, from the sealed architecture
provenance.indexing: DEFINITION_CHOICE: row-major, unit = row * 32 + col; deterministic, no RNG
provenance.hemifield: DEFINITION_CHOICE approved by the reviewer 2026-09-18: columns 0-15 to V1.1 and 16-31 to V1.2, so the two V1 instances are not redundant
provenance.targets: DERIVED: in({V1^2 X[lat]}) = V1.1.L4.E, V1.2.L4.E, as qualified in R4
provenance.receptive_fields: DEFINITION_CHOICE: contiguous equal-sized blocks in hemifield raster order, one block per target cell, assigned by floor(u * n_cells / n_units). Deterministic, non-overlapping, and exhaustive
provenance.efficacy: DEFINITION_CHOICE approved by the reviewer 2026-09-18: summed afferent weight per target cell equals 1.0x the E tonic
provenance.mechanism: DERIVED: AMPA, the only mechanism the architecture declares
provenance.stimulus: DEFINITION_CHOICE approved by the reviewer 2026-09-18: a static deterministic spot, no stochastic activation, so propagation is attributable to the stimulus
provenance.stimulus_drive: DEFINITION_CHOICE: 5.0, equal to the cortical E tonic. Realized retinal firing rate is recorded as an observation, not asserted here
provenance.tonic: DEFINITION_CHOICE: retinal tonic is zeroed, so the retina is silent absent stimulus and the drive additivity invariant reads I_executed = 0 + I_schedule on these units
provenance.no_intra_retinal_edges: DERIVED: TFNE/2 gives A^n n instances and no connectivity, and Retina is not a CTX instance, so it inherits no D4d local connectivity

kernel.reason: the qualified scientific lineage (V2.1 and the whole PV chain) executed kernel=baseline. jomission_sat_ee_v0 was qualified on star-column geometry and never on a multi-area composition, so running it here would confound the architecture with an unqualified rule transplanted to a new topology
kernel.H_recording: H, Theta and w_eff are recorded as realized. Under the baseline kernel they are expected static; a static trace is reported as static and is not evidence of stabilization
kernel.hdp_off_reason: HDP is OFF so that long-range authority is the single principal delta. Reviewer 2026-09-18: after locating the operating regime, then turn the repaired H-homeostasis back on and ask whether HDP extends and stabilizes the viable coupling range. That is a later lineage.

drive.schedule: zero everywhere except lit retinal units during the stimulation interval, where it is 5.0. Cortical neurons receive no schedule at all, so their executed input is their emitter tonic alone and no tonic is duplicated
drive.rationale: the smallest stimulus sufficient to probe propagation; this is a diagnostic input, not an omission paradigm

duration.derivation: the baseline kernel enables no HDP, so the slowest enabled relevant state is the Izhikevich recovery variable u at a = 0.02, tau approximately 50 ms; AMPA is 2 ms and GABA_A 5 ms. Settle is 40x the slowest enabled time constant. The post-stimulus interval is twice the stimulus so offset transients, runaway and drift each have room to appear after the drive is removed. Settle is extended to 10 s on the WS-DIAG-1 observation that the network had not stopped evolving at 5 s; this is a horizon correction, not a parameter tuning, and no mechanism, weight or drive is changed
duration.not_chosen_for_reassurance: no interval is longer than the failure class it must expose
duration.unchanged: stimulus 1000 ms and post-stimulus 2000 ms are exactly as sealed in WS-DIAG-1

record.groups: every populated area x layer x class, including Retina
record.y_full_resolution: FEF.L6.E v_i(t) for all 28 neurons at dt = 0.1 ms, so distribution and mean are both derivable
record.spikes: per-group spike counts per 1 ms bin, for the synchrony estimator
record.note: population summaries are binned at 1 ms; y is not binned

gates.rule: report the earliest load-bearing failure in this order; a later gate is not evaluated as the primary verdict once an earlier one fails

execution.criterion: every recorded v, u and current is finite for every step

collapse.criterion: in the final 1000 ms, every area's E population rate is at least 0.1 Hz

runaway.criterion: no class population rate exceeds 200 Hz sustained for 100 ms, and f_active does not reach 1.0 sustained for 100 ms

synchrony.criterion: for every area's E population, std/mean of the 1 ms-binned population rate over the final 1000 ms is at most 3.0
synchrony.estimator: coefficient of variation of the 1 ms population rate; predeclared before execution

drift.criterion: over the final 1500 ms of the post-stimulus interval, the least-squares slope of each area's E population rate in 100 ms bins satisfies |slope| <= 0.5 Hz/s, OR the slope is not sustained
drift.sustained_rule: a slope counts as drift only if the first and second halves of that window both exceed the tolerance with the same sign. A slow transient that is decaying fails the sustained test and is not drift
drift.predeclared: estimator and tolerance fixed before execution and not adjustable afterwards

propagation.criterion: the stimulus changes the E population rate at every hierarchical level: V1.1, at least one V4, and at least one of FEF/PFC. A change counts when the stimulus-window rate differs from the settle baseline by more than max(1 Hz, 10% of baseline)
propagation.band_authority: the sealed V2.1 band convention max(1 Hz, 10%), reused unchanged
propagation.lateral_probe: the spot lies entirely in the left hemifield, so any V1.2 change is transfer through X[lat] or the V4 level, and is reported separately rather than counted toward propagation

plumbing_check.rule: R computed with the control pair as its own test is identically zero for every area
plumbing_check.status: TAUTOLOGY, declared as such. It is X - X and is satisfied by construction. It verifies the wiring and is NOT evidence that the estimator rejects non-transmission. The reviewer's stated acceptance, g = 0 implies R_FEF = R_PFC = 0, is this identity when the control pair supplies both sides, so it is recorded here as a plumbing check and the adversarial test below is added to carry the weight the reviewer intended.

adversarial_null.rule: R evaluated on the HELD-OUT g = 0 replicate at seed 1, against the seed 0 control pair, over the four areas the stimulus cannot reach at g = 0: V4_1, V4_2, FEF, PFC
adversarial_null.expectation: non-zero but small. Its magnitude is what a non-transmitting area produces by chance under matched conditions, and it is the only defensible source for the tolerance R must exceed. It is measured here, not assumed, and is not compared against a threshold chosen in advance.
adversarial_null.added_by: the actor, because the reviewer's stated acceptance is satisfied by construction

old_gate_preserved.rule: the within-run window difference still runs and its numbers are unchanged in every cell
old_gate_preserved.reason: so this lineage's arms stay comparable to every earlier one

pass_means: no material failure was detected under these sealed first-diagnostic conditions. It does not mean the system is globally stable for arbitrary input
stop_condition: build the estimator, measure its null floor, report. No model parameter changes, no HDP, no delay change, no oscillator experiment. The oscillator discriminator is the NEXT lineage and is not opened here.
enforced_after_construction: intra-retinal edges removed and the count verified zero
the 24 cortical projection identities re-verified unchanged against the R4 receipt
observability_limit: configured tau = 2 ms; per-edge realized tau observability = unavailable
principal_delta: the propagation estimator. R_A(g) = [r_on(g) - r_off(g)] - [r_on(0) - r_off(0)], computed across four matched runs, replaces the within-run window difference computed inside one run. No architecture, weight, drive, stimulus definition, duration, kernel or other gate changes.
settle_adequacy: the pre-stimulus slope over the final 1500 ms of the settle interval is reported so the adequacy of the 10 s settle is itself observable, using the same estimator and tolerance as the drift gate. It is reported, not gated.
relation_to_parent: WS-AUTH-2 and every earlier lineage are immutable evidence and are not rewritten. This lineage repairs an instrument and qualifies what the old one could support.

coupling.specification: g_p,i = K_p,i / K_local,i, per receiving neuron
coupling.channels: g_FF = g_FB = g_X = g; FF, FB and X stay distinct relations but share one value here
coupling.g_meaning: zero long-range authority: O and X carry no current at all
coupling.ff_is_channel_level: g_FF names the pooled L2.E->L4.E and L3.E->L4.E input a cell receives. The existing relative contribution of the two motifs is preserved rather than made a new degree of freedom; because both start at the same per-edge weight, preserving it means one weight per (channel, target).
coupling.why_not_per_edge_weight: per-edge weight is the wrong primitive when convergence differs. At the inherited w = 0.5, ff onto L4.E was 35 afferents at V4_1/V4_2 but 70 at FEF/PFC, and fb onto L1.E was 28 at V1_1/V1_2 but 56 at V4_1/V4_2, so frontal cells carried exactly twice the authority of sensory cells from fan-in alone. EQUAL_G removes that.

derived_weights.note: w = g * K_local / N, with K_local = 0.8660. Predeclared so the realized values are checkable

coupling.degenerate_case: EQUAL_G at g = 0 gives w = 0 * K_local / N = 0 for every long-range edge. Verified offline before sealing: all 7020 long-range edges exactly 0.0, all 238800 local edges non-zero and bit-identical, acceptance max absolute error 0.0.

preexecution_acceptance.evaluated: before any simulation, on the float32 weights as stored, over every cell receiving long-range input
preexecution_acceptance.on_failure: the arm raises and does not run. A wrong realization must not produce a result file
invariants_asserted: exactly 7020 edges reweighted, the cross-area cortical count; 239824 untouched
every untouched weight bit-identical to the inherited edge list
delay, tau, receptor index, connectivity, drive and retinal edges unchanged
preexecution_acceptance.relative_error_undefined_at_zero: jomission/tfne/o_authority.py also reports max_rel_error, which is err/g and is therefore NaN at g = 0. Relative error against a zero target is undefined, not wrong. The pass criterion is and always was max_abs_error alone, which is exactly 0.0 here. The module is a sealed artifact (blob 13980f5a, sealed_in 74ee2cd) and was NOT edited to hide the NaN.
preexecution_acceptance.additional_invariant: every long-range cortical weight is exactly 0.0 and every local and retinal weight is bit-identical to the inherited edge list.

delay.reason: delay is independently realizable (jaxfne supports delay_storage 'per_edge') but current evidence provides no justified value. It is frozen as an inherited baseline, NOT qualified as a biological value, so that coupling gain g and temporal coupling d are not calibrated on the same lineage. Reviewer 2026-09-18: do not invent one to repair the oscillator.

predeclared_expectations.note: stated before execution so the result cannot be read as confirming whatever it produces
predeclared_expectations.old_gate_at_g0: the legacy delta_A will again report FEF and PFC responding at g = 0, as in WS-AUTH-2. That is the defect being repaired, not a new finding.
predeclared_expectations.null_floor: if the held-out null floor is large, comparable to the 0.8 Hz the old gate reported, then no propagation claim is supportable at this run length and the honest output is a bound on detectability rather than a verdict.
predeclared_expectations.if_transmission_exists: R at g = 0.5 exceeds the null floor at V4 and at the frontal areas, and V1_1 exceeds V1_2.
predeclared_expectations.if_it_does_not: R at g = 0.5 sits inside the null floor everywhere. Given WS-AUTH-2 that is a live possibility and is reported as observed, not repaired.
predeclared_expectations.no_tuning: no threshold, window, duration or stimulus is adjusted after seeing any number. If the null floor makes the gate uninformative at this run length, that is the finding.

serialization.reason: WS-AUTH-1's four arm artifacts were 16.5 MB each, of which the per-group series was essentially all, and sealing them grew .git from 20 MB to 34 MB.
serialization.what_stays_in_the_record: gates, verdict, acceptance, realization receipt, summary statistics

comparison.matched: identical architecture, retina, stimulus, drive, seed, dt, durations, gates and tolerances. The only delta against the g = 0.05 arm is g itself.

estimator.formula: R_A(g) = [r_A_on(g) - r_A_off(g)] - [r_A_on(0) - r_A_off(0)], per area, in Hz
estimator.why: the old delta_A compared two windows of one run, so anything common to those windows entered it unopposed. WS-AUTH-2 ran it at g = 0, where no current can reach FEF or PFC, and it reported +0.7971 and +0.8406 Hz there, as much as V1's +0.7536.
estimator.pairing: ON and OFF of a pair share a seed, an initial state and every other setting, so their difference is the stimulus and not the noise stream. OFF lights no retinal unit; the interface, tonic drive and all other inputs are identical.

what_each_contrast_removes.ON minus OFF: whatever is common to the baseline and stimulus windows of one run
what_each_contrast_removes.minus the g = 0 pair: whatever survives that and is still common to areas the stimulus cannot reach

design.coupled_g_reason: the top of the authorized EQUAL_G bracket, so if transmission is detectable at any authority this lineage may use, it is detectable here. A negative result at g = 0.5 bounds the estimator's sensitivity rather than proving transmission absent at every g.
design.one_process_per_cell: six separate processes, one at a time

qualification_of_historical_results.statement: the propagation field of every earlier whole-system result is NON_IDENTIFYING under this architecture. Its recorded numbers are correct as measurements of what they measured and are NOT rewritten; what changes is what may be concluded from them.
qualification_of_historical_results.evidence: results/whole_system_authority_g000.json: at g = 0 every long-range weight is exactly 0.0 and the gate still reports FEF +0.7971 Hz and PFC +0.8406 Hz
qualification_of_historical_results.method: recorded additively in the lineage registry. No sealed artifact is edited and no historical verdict is retracted; the synchrony-led verdicts of those lineages do not depend on the propagation field, which was never the first load-bearing failure in any of them.
